fact: MyJoyOnline reports GRA's Integrated Tax Administration System entered a pilot on 1 April 2026 at the Kaneshie Taxpayer Service Centre, with selected Large Taxpayer Office filers onboarded later.
MyJoyOnline reports the ITAS pilot currently covers filing of PAYE, VAT, VAT Withholding and Withholding VAT for selected taxpayers.
MyJoyOnline reports the ITAS pilot currently covers payment of PAYE, VAT, VAT Withholding and Withholding VAT, with taxpayers able to pay electronically through portals and mobile channels.
Graphic Online reports GRA began onboarding taxpayers onto ITAS, with over 400 from the Accra West Area Office onboarded in phase one and large taxpayers next.
GRA reports the launch of a pilot of ITAS at Accra West Area Office and Kaneshie TSC, replacing GITMIS and the Taxpayer Portal, with national rollout targeted for September 2026.

The GRA is deploying its Integrated Tax Administration System (ITAS) as a single platform covering registration, filing, payment and accounting, with some capabilities operational and more rolled out progressively, per Commissioner Yamborigya.
The GRA says tax payments initiated through ITAS and GITMIS are processed on the Ghana.gov payment platform and were hit by intermittent faults from 14 August 2026.
